components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button across dashboards and forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2383E2; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1D70C2; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral secondary button for filters, cancels, and secondary navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #37352F; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(55, 53, 47, 0.16); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F7F6F3; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic status indicator pill with low-saturation tint.
components.css: .ds-badge-in-progress { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #E7F3F8; color: #2383E2; }

components.name: KPI Card
components.css: .ds-card-kpi { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(55, 53, 47, 0.09); border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.04); } .ds-card-kpi-label { font-size: 12px; color: #787774; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-kpi-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #37352F; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: The Zsyio Suite design system establishes a high-density, tactile, and restrained operational environment for daily power users across Project Management, Notes, CRM, HRMS, and Core Administration. Rooted in a Notion/Linear-inspired utilitarian aesthetic, the system balances dense data tables and Kanban task flows with warm, calm typographic rhythm and zero visual noise.
keyCharacteristics: Zero AI slop: no multi-stop gradient text, floating blurred orbs, or arbitrary halos
Restrained semantic color palette with high WCAG contrast
Strict 4px/8px spatial rhythm and tabular numeric data typography
Accessible 2px focus rings across all interactive controls

rules.name: The Restrained Color Rule
rules.body: Color serves navigation, task state, and priority signaling. Backgrounds and major structural containers remain neutral.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerics Rule
rules.body: All countdowns, timestamps, currency amounts, and metric counters must use tabular figures to prevent layout jitter.

rules.name: The Accessible Focus Rule
rules.body: Never remove focus outlines without supplying an active 2px tokenized ring.

dos: Always use semantic CSS variables (--primary, --card, --border) rather than raw hex values
Apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to numbers and currency across table views
Ensure all interactive elements have visible :focus-visible styles with a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1
Keep micro-animations purposeful and brief (150ms-250ms ease-out transitions)
donts: Do not use multi-stop gradient text (background-clip: text) on headlines
Do not add decorative floating blurred orbs or glowing halos behind cards
Do not use emoji or raw unicode symbols as substitutes for cohesive Lucide SVG icons
Do not strip focus rings (outline: none !important) on form elements or editor surfaces
